code='''def transform(grid):
    a=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Panels are separated by full-color lines; infer panel interiors from separator coordinates.
    sep=next((v for v in range(1,10) if all(x==v for x in a[0]) or all(row[0]==v for row in a)),None)
    color=sep
    H,W=len(a),len(a[0])
    rs=[i for i,row in enumerate(a) if all(x==color for x in row)]
    cs=[j for j in range(W) if all(a[i][j]==color for i in range(H))]
    rb=[0]+[x+1 for x in rs]+[H]; cb=[0]+[x+1 for x in cs]+[W]
    # derive cell contents
    cells={}
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(zip(rb,rb[1:])):
      for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(zip(cb,cb[1:])):
        cells[ri,ci]=[(r-r0,c-c0,a[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if a[r][c] not in (0,color)]
    # Reflect contents across horizontal panel boundary from third panel row to fourth.
    nrows=max(k[0] for k in cells)+1; ncols=max(k[1] for k in cells)+1
    for ci in range(ncols):
      src=cells.get((nrows-2,ci),[]); r0,r1=rb[nrows-1],rb[nrows]
      if src:
        # use destination dimensions; vertical reflection
        sh=r1-r0
        for rr,cc,v in src:
          tr=sh-1-rr
          if 0<=tr<sh and c0<=cc: pass
          a[r0+tr][cb[ci]+cc]=v
    # replicate second panel column from first occupied shape in second panel row
    if ncols>=2 and nrows>=2:
      src=cells.get((1,0),[])
      if src:
        r0,r1=rb[1],rb[2]
        for rr,cc,v in src:
          a[r0+rr][cb[1]+cc]=v
    return a
'''
